original_query: What is the media with the most sway on a buyer's consideration list?

summaries.found_via_query: What media type has the most sway on a buyer's consideration list?
summaries.summary: The infographic highlights that TV advertising has the most sway on a buyer's consideration list, with 70% of respondents indicating it has strong influence. Other media types include online video ads (36%), search engine results/ads (55%), and reviews on vehicle review sites (80%). The data is from a CAB Automotive Buyers Study conducted in December 2011, targeting buyers aged 25-54.
key_facts: TV advertising has the most sway with 70% of respondents.
Reviews on vehicle review sites have 80% strong influence.
The study is from CAB Automotive Buyers Study, Dec 2011, targeting A25-54.
